avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immunostimulant may counteract ustekinumab's immunosuppressive effects and reduce therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before using

avoid_supplements.name: Astragalus
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune-enhancing supplement may antagonize IL-12/IL-23 inhibition and decrease drug effectiveness
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; discontinue if patient wishes to initiate

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modulate immune response; generally considered safe but monitor for unexpected immunological changes
caution_supplements.action: Use with awareness; monitor clinical response and infection signs

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Supports immune homeostasis; may interact with IL-12/IL-23 pathway but typically beneficial in immunosuppressed patients
caution_supplements.action: Monitor levels; supplementation may be appropriate with prescriber guidance

caution_foods.name: High-sugar foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May impair immune function in already immunosuppressed patients; increases infection risk

monitoring_notes: Ustekinumab is a monoclonal antibody not metabolized by hepatic enzymes, so traditional drug-supplement interactions are minimal. Primary concern is avoiding immunostimulant supplements that could antagonize therapeutic effect; monitor for infection risk and maintain appropriate vaccination status per prescriber recommendations.
